title: PhyWorld: Physics-Faithful World Model for Video Generation
author: Pu Zhao; Juyi Lin; Timothy Rupprecht; Arash Akbari; Chence Yang; Rahul Chowdhury; Elaheh Motamedi; Arman Akbari; Yumei He; Chen Wang; Geng Yuan; Weiwei Chen; Yanzhi Wang
summary: PhyWorld is a video generation model that creates videos following real physical laws and keeps scenes consistent over time. It uses a two-step training process to improve video quality and ensure physical accuracy. Tests show PhyWorld makes more realistic and physically correct videos than other models.
